shared_elements: large single male human figure dominating the field
elaborately dressed hair/headdress rendered as rows of curls or striations
beard or heavy jaw framing the face
circular disc or medallion ornament on the chest area
incised surface detail over a body form
arms/hands brought toward the chest with carried attributes
justification: Both depict a single monumental male figure with a heavily worked coiffure of stacked curls, a beard, a chest disc/medallion and a belted robe, which is a reasonably specific combination of person-plus-ornament. But A is a flat profile relief of a winged, striding figure with raised hand and carried implements, while B is a volumetric frontal image with no wings, no stride and no legible held objects, so the relationships and rendering conventions diverge sharply.
